name: Giant Rocktopus
publisher: Wizards of the Coast LLC with Green Ronin Publishing
section: chapter 2, Into Darkness, Creature Encounters, Giant “Rocktopus”
sourceWitness: Page images of the English first printing and a separate OCR witness.
sourcePageKind: D&D Beyond public index identifies the adventure and chapter. The chapter and standalone creature links redirect to the purchase page without access. The reproduced printed page supplies rules.
errataEvidence: Wizards of the Coast Out of the Abyss errata v1.1, 2020, contains no change to this Beast.
habitatEvidence: Underdark habitat is supported by the adventure encounter and publisher catalog.
appearanceEvidence: Page 28 describes a terrestrial octopus capable of looking like rock and specifies no fixed color or change to eyes or limbs. The neutral reused image has mottled coloration and a knobbly mantle.
proficiencyEvidence: Derived from challenge rating using the 2014 Monster Manual. The book does not print a separate proficiency line.
sourceNotes: The passage calls it a Giant Octopus variant and supplies walk 20 ft. and climb 10 ft. It removes Hold Breath and replaces Underwater Camouflage with unconditional Camouflage.
The passage gives no explicit replacement for swim 60 ft., Water Breathing, or Ink Cloud. Tentacles retains the base attack.
The inherited Water Breathing trait conflicts with the published land ecology. Allowing it to breathe air is a table ruling.

sourceNotes: The September 2015 first printing identifies Male Steeder as a Medium Beast. The public legacy creature index displays Monstrosity. The original adventure stat block supplies the classification and mechanics here.
